comparisons.reason: Different quantifiers and null rules. Item 0 is an 'any' measure: 1 if at least one comment mainly appeals to abstract normative principles, and an empty list gives 0. Item 1 is an 'all/solely' measure: 1 only if the list is nonempty and every comment is purely abstract normative with no concrete details or non-normative argumentation, and an empty list gives null. Item 1 also adds explicit exclusions for quoted text and bot notices. Any versus all, and the empty-list handling (0 versus null), are material differences.
